description: This file defines utility functions for string splitting, providing a method to split a string into a linked list of tokens based on spaces.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing string splitting utilities.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a source string into tokens separated by spaces and returns them as a linked list.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it is valid and non-empty.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is valid (not empty).
